dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, discrete white circular and elliptical patches visible against a dark gray/black ground on the coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent high-contrast white spots create a serrated appearance along the visible edges of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct horizontal rectangular white band traversing the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharply defined by a transverse white band separating the dark crown from the dark mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric pairs of high-contrast white patches located on the upper dorsal surface above the wing chord.
